newsitem.title: USA: ADC falls on delay in detailing contracts.
newsitem.headline: ADC falls on delay in detailing contracts.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc's stock fell after the company told an analysts' meeting Wednesday it may announce details of only one of four new cable telephony contracts by the end of 1996, analysts said.
"That's what has spooked the stock," said Robert W. Baird & Co analyst Theodore Moreau, who said investors were overreacting. ADC Telecom was trading at 34-3/4, off 4-1/2.

"It's our understanding that there is no change in the nature of the contracts or the amount of contracts. The only thing is they might not announce who they are with by yearend," Moreau told Reuters.

Analysts said ADC Telecommunications is on record that it has added four new significant contracts, three with international service providers and one with a domestic cable company, that would boost its backlog to $800 million from $400 million.
ADC Telecommunications officials were not immediately available for comment.
